content.comment_body: I have a network bit (NI1) assigned to address v249.0, but when I use Modbus/TCP, I actually need to read or write to address 125 for proper operation. This functions correctly, but could someone explain how this address mapping works? I'm trying to understand how the internal network bit address corresponds to the Modbus address.
You asked the same question in the German section of the forum. Looking for assistance? I have already provided an answer to this topic there.
Thread closed since the question was posted twice. The second thread titled 'Help?' appears in the [product_name] - Communication section. Best regards, [user_name]
